text: ReraRO yatkarma RO cet sa kartA'nADyAne
transliteration: ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cet sa kartā'nādhyāne

text: karmaRi ca yena saMsparSAt kartuH SarIrasuKam
transliteration: karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśāt kartuḥ śarīrasukham

text: kriyAsamaBihAre low; lowo hisvO; vA ca taDvamoH
transliteration: kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ; loṭo hisvau; vā ca tadhvamoḥ

text: janapadinAM janapadavat sarvaM janapadena samAnaSabdAnAM bahuvacane
transliteration: janapadināṃ janapadavat sarvaṃ janapadena samānaśabdānāṃ bahuvacane

text: tadvAnAsAmupaDAno mantra itIzwakAsu luk ca matoH
transliteration: tadvānāsāmupadhāno mantra itīṣṭakāsu luk ca matoḥ

text: na yvAByAM padAntAByAm pUrvO tu tAByAmEc
transliteration: na yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyām pūrvau tu tābhyāmaic

text: radAByAM nizWAto naH pUrvasya ca daH
transliteration: radābhyāṃ niṣṭhāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ
